free_tier.stated: 3 active tunnels and custom subdomains, no account

retention.stated: the assigned hostname is unusable, so nothing is served for any period

egress.terms: not published; the assigned hostname resolves to 0.0.0.0 and ::, so no byte is reachable

chaining: composes with nothing: the SSH leg succeeds and the HTTP leg has no DNS record.

limits.value: the tunnel hostname has no usable A or AAAA record, so the data path does not exist
anonymous raw TCP: one random port for 10 minutes, two connections, 256 KiB/s cap; with a key: 30 minutes, five connections, 1 MiB/s
public TCP and UDP forwarding are paid-only
a large transfer is cut at about 2.4-2.5 MiB after about 10 s on the anonymous tier

identity_cost.detail: the ssh target needs no account; a key is optional for reserved names

reliability_note: the SSH banner printed a tunnel URL that has no usable DNS record, on two separate sessions; a harness measured a 710 ms median latency and a 4 MiB transfer cut at about 2.4-2.5 MiB after about 10 s, while the tunnel itself stayed up.

evidence.proved: 3 active tunnels and custom subdomains on the free plan
the hostname from the SSH banner resolves to 0.0.0.0 and :: from 8.8.8.8; two sessions, two dead names, curl exits 6
'wg.serveo.net:51820 is the public UDP endpoint used to connect to Serveo.' and 'Paid accounts can forward a raw TCP or UDP port through a WireGuard peer.'
'Public UDP forwarding remains a paid WireGuard feature.' and the anonymous raw TCP cap
'Get 3 active tunnels and custom subdomains for $0/month' and Pro at $60/yr
a 4 MiB transfer is cut at about 2.4-2.5 MiB after about 10 s while the tunnel stays up

notes: Serveo provides SSH and WireGuard port forwarding. Free tiers receive an HTTP hostname; raw public TCP and UDP forwarding require a paid Pro subscription at $60 annually. A sandbox measured a 710 ms median latency and a transfer cut at about 2.4-2.5 MiB after about 10 s on 2026-11-05, while the tunnel stayed up.

extras.verified_at_basis: pages read and probes run in this session on 2026-10-22
extras.transit_note: the control plane answers and the data path does not exist: the assigned hostname resolves to 0.0.0.0 and ::

binding_note: with no resolvable address there is no meter and no capacity; the control plane is the whole product that works.
confidence_note: the anonymous tier carries about 230 kB/s and cuts a transfer at about 2.4-2.5 MiB after about 10 s, while the tunnel stays up (measured 2026-11-05).
